input.subject: 7 Brackenmere Walk, Vellumford, ZZ1 1ZZ - end-of-occupancy work
input.body:
Address: 7 Brackenmere Walk, Vellumford, ZZ1 1ZZ

Hi Perrin,

We have a note on file that the clear-out and property service at the above property took place on Tuesday 23 September 2025. Please can you confirm whether you attended, and on what date, and tell us exactly what was completed. In particular, please confirm whether the remaining items were removed from the kitchen drawers, the garden storage box, the kitchen bins and the cellar (vacuum, sweeping brush, dustpan, mop and toilet brush), as these were not listed in your quotation NBL-024-Q1 of 9 September.

Please also send the completion photographs you mentioned, and tell us if you intend to charge anything beyond your quoted £180.00 + VAT (£216.00 including VAT). The landlord's approval of the quote is still outstanding on our side, so please do not carry out any further work at the property until you hear from us.

Kind regards
Northbridge Lettings

input.decision: Stage: a quote with the landlord, but work reported done (an agency checkout clean and clear-out at a vacant property). Rules: PM-AUTH-002, PM-AUTH-001, PM-DOC-001, PM-CLOSE-001. Evidence: events 011, 017, 018, 019, 020, 021. Larkspan quoted £180 + VAT (£216 inc VAT) in event 011, for cleaning only. The quote does not include removing the items in the kitchen drawers, garden storage box, kitchen bins and cellar. The workflow put it above the £100 threshold and sent it to the landlord for approval (events 017, 018). She was chased in event 019 and no reply is recorded. Event 020 is an internal note saying the work was done on 23/09, but there is no landlord approval, no completion photos and no invoice. The approval flag in event 002 has no supporting document. Next steps, in order: (1) I have emailed Larkspan to confirm what was done and when, including whether the items were removed, to send the completion photos and any charges beyond the quote, and to do no further work. (2) The case is on hold Waiting for Provider, with a chase on 26/09. (3) A P1 handover asks the duty manager to decide how to put the unapproved work to the landlord and ask for approval after the fact, how the item removal will be priced, and how the cost links to the pending deposit claim. I have not told the landlord the work is complete, I have not approved the quote and I have not closed the case.
